abstract: McKinsey's November 2025 survey finds that AI adoption has become nearly ubiquitous among organizations, with 88% using AI in at least one function and 71% adopting generative AI. However, the research reveals a significant scaling gap: only 7% of organizations have fully scaled their AI initiatives, and merely 6% report earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) impact of 5% or more, suggesting that widespread adoption has not yet translated into substantial business value for most enterprises.
keyFindings: 88% of organizations use AI in at least one function, up from 78% in prior measurement periods.
Generative AI adoption reached 71% among surveyed organizations.
Only 7% of organizations have fully scaled their AI implementations.
Just 6% of organizations report EBIT impact of 5% or greater from their AI initiatives.
62% of organizations are experimenting with AI agents.
methodology: Not specified in provided excerpt. Appears to be a quantitative survey of organizations but sample size, sampling methodology, and detailed survey parameters are not detailed in the available text.
